How does Disney make animated movies?
From beginning to end, making an animated movie can take several years. Starting with a simple idea, movies progress through animation elements like storyboarding, defining an overall look, modeling any 3D elements, and adding effects, before the visuals are rendered and combined with sound elements like dialogue and music.
